person_note: The quote set repeatedly exposes participating narration through “I,” “my,” “me,” and “our,” including sustained action and interiority rather than isolated speech. The two described viewpoint strands belong to Casey and Ella, but both are first person, so their alternation does not meet the cross-person requirement for ALTERNATING. Dialogue-only first-person language was excluded, while clipped passages were kept unresolved locally. Commercial whole-book analysis, a professional review, and chapter-level close reading agree with the quote evidence. Confidence is medium because no authorized sustained excerpt or scholarly whole-book source was accessible.
